top_signals.title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts, US CPI Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary:
Traders piled back into the artificial intelligence trade, lifting US stock futures following strong results from beaten-down neocloud firm CoreWeave and robust demand for Anthropic’s initial public offering.

The US bond market tumbled in yesterday's trade, sending short-term yields surging by the most in 19 months, after consumer prices rose at a faster-than-expected pace and Federal Reserve officials warned the central bank may need to increase interest rates more aggressively.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: South Sudan Courts Oil Investors as Sudan’s Warring Forces Take Their Share
top_signals.summary: South Sudan is courting fresh capital for 14 exploration blocks and a production increase from roughly 170,000 barrels per day to 230,000, which investors would find impossible to control once those barrels left the country. Captive to neighboring Sudan’s civil war, South Sudan is essentially divvying up its oil, under duress, between the Sudanese Army and the rival paramilitary RSF, which extract payment before the oil can reach the Red Sea. The government-backed South Sudan Oil & Power conference will put that proposition before investors…
